# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported |
|---------|-----------|
| testnet (current) | Yes |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do NOT report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

Email: security@gaekju.xyz

Include:
- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Suggested fix (if any)

## Response Timeline

- **72 hours** — acknowledge receipt
- **7 days** — initial assessment
- **30 days** — target fix for critical issues

## Scope

In scope:
- Smart contracts (`contracts/src/`)
- Keeper bots (`crates/gaekju-keeper/`)
- Mirror agent (`crates/gaekju-mirror/`)
- API server (`crates/gaekju-api/`)

Out of scope:
- Frontend applications
- Third-party dependencies (report to upstream)
- Testnet USDC (not real money)

## Bug Bounty

Planned for mainnet launch. Not currently active for testnet.
